title: Cambridge IELTS 20 Academic Speaking Test 2 (Online Test)

parts.title: Part 1 — Introduction and interview
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask general questions about yourself and a few familiar topics. Answer naturally and try to extend each answer with a reason or example. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: Are there any kinds of fruit that you don't like eating?
Do you like eating cooked food that has fruit in it?
Where's the best place to buy fruit where you live?

parts.title: Part 2 — Individual long turn
parts.instructions: You will be given a topic card. You have one minute to prepare and may make notes. Then speak for one to two minutes. Try to keep talking until the examiner stops you.
parts.cue_card_topic: Describe a time when you changed a plan you had made.
cue_card_bullets: and explain how you felt about changing your plan

parts.title: Part 3 — Two-way discussion
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask further questions connected to the Part 2 topic. These are more abstract and require you to explain, compare, and speculate. Try to give extended, well-reasoned answers. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: What kinds of plans do friends make together?
Do you think it's better to discuss future plans with friends or with family?
When making plans for the future, is it important not to copy friends?
When people are choosing what to study, how important is it that their course should lead directly to a career?
Why is it a good idea to get some work experience before deciding on a future career?
How easy do you think it is for people to change from one career to another?
